text: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weight model for agent tasks, under the Apache 2.0 license. Meta says it runs on one consumer GPU at 4-bit precision and beats Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use. The technical report is on arXiv.
